svg.title: Every one of the specimen's 1007 parameters, followed through training.
svg.desc: Time runs down the plate on a logarithmic scale (700 AdamW steps, lr 1e-2, 20 warmup steps, cosine to 1e-4, clip 1, seed 0); each path's horizontal position is the value of one parameter θᵢ, from -1.24 to 2.32. The left family starts near zero; the right family is the 24 LayerNorm gains, which start at exactly 1. In value ink: the 56 coordinates of the embedding E. Eight paths do not visibly move: the key bias b_k, whose gradient vanishes identically; floating-point rounding moves them by about 10⁻¹¹.
